lines.text: Joshua, old and well along in years, summoned all Israel, including its elders, leaders, judges, and officers.
Joshua said the LORD fought for Israel and that the land stretched from the Jordan westward to the Red Sea.
Joshua told Israel to keep all that is written in the Law of Moses and hold fast to the LORD.
Joshua said one Israelite could put a hundred to flight, because the LORD their God fights for them.
Joshua said not one of the LORD's good promises had failed, and breaking the covenant would bring His anger.
